_comment: Perfil_CSF REAL del engagement, producido por el subagente GRC cableado al Power grc-nist-csf. target_tier = 3 (Repeatable). INVARIANTE del design.md: subcategorias con gap==true == conjunto de csf_subcategory del POA&M == subcategorias referenciadas por los riesgos de risk_register.real.json (Req 6.9, 19.5). IDs CSF verificados contra powers/grc-nist-csf/core/csf-2.0-core.csv (R1). Textos oficiales incluidos para didactica. Deja intacta la plantilla csf_profile.json.
tier_justification: El engagement tiene politicas ad-hoc (scope.yaml existe pero no hay politica formal del SGSI); se evaluan riesgos pero sin apetito aprobado; sin monitoreo continuo. Objetivo 3 (Repeatable) en 12 meses requiere politicas formales, metricas y Blue Team.

subcategories.text_official: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity - including privacy and civil liberties obligations - are understood and managed
subcategories.note: El engagement documenta principios eticos (authorization-first, do-no-harm, legal-compliance), ventana autorizada y acciones prohibidas

subcategories.text_official: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident
subcategories.note: Analisis de causa raiz realizado en inc-0002 (concatenacion sin escape en shell_exec del modulo exec)

subcategories.text_official: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved
subcategories.note: Cadena de custodia enlazada por prev_sha256 + write-once en raw/

subcategories.text_official: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle
subcategories.note: CWE-78 demostrado en nivel Low de DVWA; concatenacion shell_exec sin escape es fallo de SDLC

subcategories.text_official: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties
subcategories.note: Cookie PHPSESSID sin HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite reutilizable; cookie 'security' decide nivel desde el cliente

subcategories.text_official: Configuration management practices are established and applied
subcategories.note: Apache 2.4.25 con banner expuesto, sin HSTS/CSP/XFO/XCTO/HTTPS; falta hardening de cabeceras HTTP

subcategories.text_official: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
subcategories.note: No hay registro de deteccion del escaneo nmap ni del PoC CWE-78; Blue Team es hueco de baseline

poam.milestone: Parchar concatenacion shell_exec en modulo exec de DVWA; validar con reescaneo + revision de codigo
HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=Strict en PHPSESSID; rotacion tras login; retirar cookie 'security' y moverla al server
Cabeceras HSTS/XFO/XCTO/CSP; ocultar banner; habilitar HTTPS con cert valido
Enviar access/error log al SIEM; alertas sobre payloads sospechosos; dashboard de 4xx/5xx; revision semanal
poam.owner: blue-team (hueco de baseline; tarea del alumno)
